findings.title: The 'ask' handoff branch deletes trial answers without asking
findings.problem: When guestHandoff returns "ask", the app immediately clears both the device copy and the held copy. No Add/Discard choice is rendered. This loses trial answers and directly contradicts the handoff contract added to PULSERN_BUILD.md and documented in progress-load.js.
findings.failure_scenario: A visitor completes the trial and signs into an older account, including an older account with no saved progress. The trial is deleted automatically, and the app displays "Welcome back" instead of asking what to do. An unknown account creation date takes the same destructive path.
findings.fix: Keep the trial intact while presenting an explicit account-specific Add/Discard decision. Clear it only after explicit Discard or a successful save containing the consented import. Update the browser tests that currently assert automatic deletion to exercise the actual consent flow.

findings.title: Legacy reviews use different history matching for selection and XP
findings.problem: Review selection can recognize an unscoped legacy row by its numeric ID, but answerXp only recognizes canonical keys. Until classifyLog runs successfully, a review that is already known to be a miss is paid as a first correct answer. A previously correct scheduled review can also receive first-answer XP again.
findings.failure_scenario: The question-bank request succeeds but the independent case-catalog request fails, so App never runs classifyLog. A legacy row {id: 42, correct: false} with a numeric review schedule is served as bank:42 by reviewPools. A considered correct answer to this difficulty-2 item earns 20 XP instead of the 5-XP correction award because sameAnswer cannot match the old row. The same mismatch occurs during the catalog-loading window.
findings.fix: Make actionable review selection and reward calculation consume the same safely resolved identity/history. Resolve unambiguous legacy rows before awarding XP, or defer the award until provenance is established without guessing across collisions. Add a regression covering a legacy review when the bank loads but the case catalog fails, asserting both the schedule and exact XP.

findings.title: Deferred unresolved reviews survive the end of their sitting
findings.problem: Choosing "Leave unresolved" adds the legacy ID to resolvedLegacy.current, and pickFrom excludes that ID through deferred. endSession resets navigation but never clears this set, so subsequent sittings on the same Practice screen cannot open the unresolved item again.
findings.failure_scenario: An unresolved miss is the only available review. The student opens Review misses, chooses Leave unresolved, and returns to the session menu. Review misses still shows one item, but opening it again produces an empty session. The student cannot identify that review until leaving Practice and forcing QBank to remount.
findings.fix: Scope deferred unresolved IDs to one sitting. Clear the set when ending or explicitly starting a new sitting, while retaining it during automatic continuation so the same unresolved card is not immediately re-served. Test leaving an item unresolved and then reopening Review misses without remounting QBank.

assessment: Do not merge yet. The change can silently discard trial work, award incorrect XP for legacy reviews, and make unresolved reviews inaccessible across sittings. These findings are based on the supplied code and images; I could not execute the tests.
